artifact_check_source:
import hashlib,json,sys,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('__LOCAL_HOME__/Projects/JavaProjects/docweave');ns={'m':'http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0'};parent=ET.parse(root/'pom.xml').getroot();license=(root/'LICENSE').read_bytes();rows=[]
for element in parent.findall('m:modules/m:module',ns):
 module=element.text;p=root/module;model=ET.parse(p/'pom.xml').getroot();artifact=model.findtext('m:artifactId',namespaces=ns);stem=p/'target'/f'{artifact}-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT'
 if model.findtext('m:properties/m:maven.deploy.skip',namespaces=ns)=='true':
  assert not Path(str(stem)+'-sources.jar').exists(),module
  assert not Path(str(stem)+'-javadoc.jar').exists(),module
  continue
 archives={}
 for classifier in ('','-sources','-javadoc'):
  jar=Path(str(stem)+classifier+'.jar')
  with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as z:
   names=z.namelist();licensepath='resources/META-INF/LICENSE' if classifier=='-javadoc' and module!='docweave-all' else 'META-INF/LICENSE';assert z.read(licensepath)==license,(module,classifier,licensepath)
   if classifier=='-sources':
    for source in (p/'src/main/java').rglob('*.java'):assert z.read(source.relative_to(p/'src/main/java').as_posix())==source.read_bytes(),source
   if classifier=='-javadoc':
    assert 'META-INF/README.md' in names if module=='docweave-all' else 'index.html' in names,module
   if module=='docweave-layout-onnx':
    notice='META-INF/Microsoft-TATR-LICENSE.txt';entry='resources/'+notice if classifier=='-javadoc' else notice;assert z.read(entry)==(p/'src/main/resources'/notice).read_bytes(),classifier
   assert not any(n.endswith(('.onnx','.traineddata','.pdf','.docx')) for n in names),(module,classifier)
   archives[classifier or 'binary']=dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(jar.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=jar.stat().st_size,entries=len(names),license_entry=licensepath)
 rows.append(dict(module=module,artifact=artifact,archives=archives))
assert len(rows)==16,len(rows)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(runtime=sys.argv[2],publishable_jar_modules=len(rows),internal_harness_attachments_absent=True,artifacts=rows),indent=2)+'\n')
print('Verified binary/source/documentation archives for all16 publishable JAR modules; internal attachments absent.')
consumer_execution_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
for version in 21 25; do
 repo="/tmp/docweave-consumer-m2-java${version}"
 mkdir -p "$repo/io/docweave"
 for artifact in docweave-parent docweave-core docweave-pdf; do cp -a "/tmp/docweave-m2/io/docweave/$artifact" "$repo/io/docweave/"; done
 if [ "$version" = 21 ]; then export JAVA_HOME=/tmp/docweave-jdk21; else export JAVA_HOME=__LOCAL_HOME__/.sdkman/candidates/java/25.0.4-amzn; fi
 export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:__LOCAL_HOME__/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
 mvn -B -ntp -s /tmp/docweave-pdf-consumer/settings.xml -Dmaven.repo.local="$repo" -f /tmp/docweave-pdf-consumer/pom.xml clean package > "/tmp/docweave-consumer-build-java${version}.log" 2>&1
 python3 /tmp/docweave-consumer-run.py "$version" "$repo" "$JAVA_HOME"
done
consumer_classpath_check_source:
import json,subprocess,sys,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
version,repo,jdk=sys.argv[1:];repo=Path(repo);jar=Path('/tmp/docweave-pdf-consumer/target/pdf-consumer-1.0.jar')
with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as z:
 raw=z.read('META-INF/MANIFEST.MF').decode().replace('\r\n','\n').replace('\n ','')
 manifest=dict(line.split(': ',1) for line in raw.splitlines() if ': ' in line)
 names=manifest['Class-Path'].split();paths=[]
 for name in names:
  matches=list(repo.rglob(name));assert len(matches)==1,(name,matches);paths.append(matches[0])
 projects=sorted(p.name for p in paths if '/io/docweave/' in str(p))
 assert projects==['docweave-core-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar','docweave-pdf-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar'],projects
 assert not any(any(forbidden in str(p).lower() for forbidden in ['poi','jackson','jsoup','tesseract','onnxruntime']) for p in paths),paths
 classpath=':'.join(map(str,[jar,*paths]))
 result=subprocess.run([jdk+'/bin/java','-Djava.awt.headless=true','-cp',classpath,'PdfConsumer'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
 Path(f'/tmp/docweave-consumer-run-java{version}.log').write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
 Path(f'/tmp/docweave-consumer-java{version}.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(java=version,dependencies=[str(p.relative_to(repo)) for p in paths],stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,source_class_major_version=int.from_bytes(z.read('PdfConsumer.class')[6:8],'big')),indent=2)+'\n')
 print(result.stdout.strip())
